triggers.text: You came out of that alive. That's more than I expected. Come by the Afterlife.
triggers.note: The Smasher hunt and her unresolved bond with Johnny.

triggers.text: Notice you're around more. Fine. Don't make a habit of it.
triggers.note: The level title and her dry acceptance.

triggers.text: Heard you set the city on fire. Do you need a place to hide?
triggers.note: The wanted level, her contacts, and the Afterlife as a place to hide.

triggers.text: Can't sleep. Neither can I. Come have a coffee. Keep it quiet.
triggers.note: The hour, her fatigue, and the fact that the Afterlife is closing.

triggers.text: I saw you at the door. Come up to the booth when you're done.
triggers.note: She can see the front door and wants V for a small job.

triggers.text: Don't read into the movie. I didn't.
triggers.note: The drive-in and her guarded warmth.

triggers.text: That went fine. Don't tell the others it went well.
